category_title: Students with autism who communicate via typing and require significant wait time for responses
minimal_context: The teacher is asking summary questions to the class about state government voter qualifications while the student sits with an adult taking notes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review the section on state government. What are the four voter qualifications?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly next to the adult who takes notes for him.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (There is a silent pause of about five seconds. His hand stays at his side.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Does anyone else know? You can just yell out your answers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (As another student begins to give her answer, he raises his left hand slowly, looking unable to participate because his typing is much slower.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's review the section on state government. What are the four voter qualifications?

STUDENT: (Sits quietly next to the adult who takes notes for him.)

TUTOR: Shaffer, what are they?

STUDENT: (There is a silent pause of about five seconds. His hand stays at his side.)

TUTOR: Does anyone else know? You can just yell out your answers.

STUDENT: (As another student begins to give her answer, he raises his left hand slowly, looking unable to participate because his typing is much slower.)
